# Orbis Team

> Orbis Team is an independent, boutique advertising agency specializing in retail media, connected television (CTV), and programmatic advertising. It combines 35+ years of combined media planning and execution experience ($250M+ in managed ad revenue) and 24/7 campaign monitoring with strategy and judgment that AI can't replace. No holding company and no platform volume commitments, so recommendations are conflict-free.

Based in Charleston, SC; serves brands across the US. Contact: info@orbisteam.com · +1-917-764-3354

## Services
- Retail Media Activation: campaigns across the premier retail media networks, onsite, offsite and connected, using commerce-first audience data.
- Connected Television: streaming campaigns tied to real outcomes, with verified household data and lift measurement.
- Programmatic Display & Audience Targeting: audience-first programmatic across open web, mobile and in-app, built for the post-cookie world.
- Omnichannel Media Planning: unified plans across CTV, display, digital audio, social extensions and print.
- Unique Market Solutions
- Strategy, Analytics & Measurement

## Pricing
Monthly retainers; fees exclude media spend, which is billed at cost with no markup from Orbis Team. Every tier has the same inventory access (retail media networks, CTV, podcast and audio, programmatic display and video via 20+ DSPs, bespoke solutions); tiers differ by channel count. Full details and FAQ: https://www.orbisteam.com/pricing
- Launch: $10,000/month. Up to two channels (most pair display with video or CTV); a third channel is $10,000/month with a 90-day commitment.
- Accelerate: from $25,000/month. Up to three channels; additional channels $10,000 per channel per month.
- Dominate: from $50,000/month. All channels, no per-channel add-ons, category exclusivity (no direct competitors taken on while a client); for multi-team or multi-brand budgets.
